hero.lead: Every ride on the Cổ Cò prairie begins with understanding and complete respect for the lives, condition and natural psychology of our horses.
hero.insuranceText: Full eco-sports insurance is included for every guest who books in advance.

attire.title: Neat, Practical Attire
attire.text: Closed-toe shoes or quality leather boots with stretch trousers are preferred. Flip-flops and high heels are never allowed, to protect your balance and safety.

helmet.title: CE / ASTM Certified Helmet
helmet.text: International-standard riding helmets are ready in every head size. Your trainer personally adjusts the chin strap before you approach a horse.

coaching.title: 1:1 Coaching and Horse Psychology
coaching.text: Your trainer stays with you throughout. Never approach from the blind spot behind the tail, never make sudden noises and learn to communicate through calm breathing.

steps.title: 4 Golden Steps Before You Mount
steps.description: At Bách Mã Viên we keep a noble riding culture alongside Western freedom. Every guest goes through a four-stage safety process.
steps.hotlineText: Call our ranch team directly with any questions about health or eligibility.

s1.title: Fitness and Riding Experience Check
s1.text: We listen and assess your flexibility and experience with horses (never ridden, beginner or semi-pro) to match you with the horse whose temperament suits you best.

s2.title: Fitting and Trying on Protective Gear
s2.text: Put on your helmet and protective shoes or ankle boots, and a back protector if you join the free trail along the Cổ Cò river.

s3.title: 15-Minute Warm-Up and Reading the Horse
s3.text: Stroke the neck, learn to speak in a calm low voice and stay out of the blind spot behind the tail to build mutual trust.

s4.title: Lead-Line Coaching, One to One
s4.text: Beginners always have a professional handler on the lead line. Only when you fully control the walk do you move on to the trot.

cta.title: Need advice for a special event?
cta.text: We host Bohemian-style weddings, anniversaries and corporate workshops on our wide grass lawns.
